import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read and summarize the provided CSV by city.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')
avg_temp = df.groupby('city')['temp_c'].mean().round(0)
# Round averages to the nearest 5 degrees.
rounded_temp = (avg_temp / 5).round() * 5

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))
ax.bar(rounded_temp.index, rounded_temp.values)
ax.set_ylabel('Average temperature (°C), rounded to nearest 5°')
ax.set_title('Average Temperature by City')
ax.set_ylim(0, max(rounded_temp.values) * 1.15)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
